addresses.name: UndeclaredWarCoversProvince
addresses.comment: Body 0x4763A0-0x4763EB, bare ret, both arguments in registers. For each element of the vector at war->+0x28/+0x2C (the war's regions) it walks province->+0x358 (the province's region list, next at +8) and answers true on the first element the province also holds. **29 direct callers, and seven inlined copies** - ComputePlanForces (0x8B5B84, two in the airborne half at 0x8B72E1/0x8B768E), RebuildFrontAndApproaches (0x8BC6E4), PlanParadrops (0x8CD4B0), ManageLandUnits (0x8D72B3), slot 76 (0x8DB8B6) - all the tail of a hostility test of the shape `at war, or REB, or (an undeclared war covers this province)`. Reached from the province-taking IsEnemy (CCountry::IsEnemy, 0x2F210, 101 calls, only one with no province) and the combat and raid checks; the Lua-registered IsEnemy (0x2F1B0) has no province and never sees an undeclared war. The class is from locality plus the loader: 0x4763A0 sits inside the undeclared_war.cpp translation unit and CUndeclaredWar::LoadKey has a `region` key. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-scriptgaps.md, section 4, lists every consumer.
